svg.title: FIG 01 · inference pipeline
svg.desc: Blueprint of the meter-reading OCR pipeline: photo, meter presence (MobileViTv2, 3x256x256), dial detection (YOLO26n-OBB, 3x352x352), digital or analog (MobileViTv2), OCR (SVTRv2 + CTC), reading. All models run as TensorRT FP16 engines on Triton on an NVIDIA L4. Pulses show a photo moving through it.
svg.text: one photo in, one reading out · every stage is a tensorrt fp16 engine on triton
TRITON INFERENCE SERVER · gRPC · 9 × TENSORRT FP16 · NVIDIA L4
